proves.claim: A gate job settled green, and one settled red on the item's own case, each append one gate_settled event naming the job, its outcome and the class item.

api.io-gate.settled-green-and-item-red.why: Without this test the board never records when a gate settled or how, so the timeline reader and settle-latency measurements have nothing to read.

proves.claim: A gate job that settles through the shard path, is seen again by the waiting-gate pass, or has its receipt applied twice still has exactly one gate_settled event.

api.io-gate.settled-once-per-job.why: Without this test each re-seen settle adds another event, and settle counts and latencies read from the events are wrong.
